name: Crescent City Kingpin
description: Rise from a corner po-boy shop to kingpin of modern-day New Orleans. Drive the French Quarter, take over rival turf in gunfights, run import deliveries and grow your clubs, boats and casino empire, solo or with friends.
tips: Press E at Mama Nola's to shop for guns and cars.
Beat a gang, then its boss, to take the district.
Press E by a parked car to hop in. Shift brakes hard.
Run import deliveries by car before the timer ends.
Hurt civilians or cops and the heat rises. Hide to cool off.
